description: Bare HTTP/1.1 on Kotlin coroutines + Java NIO2 — AsynchronousServerSocketChannel wrapped with suspendCancellableCoroutine, one channel per core with SO_REUSEPORT. Each connection runs as a coroutine with async reads/writes. Hand-rolled request parser: request line, headers, Content-Length and chunked bodies, keep-alive. No HTTP framework, no Ktor.
